rca of the issue: Reproduction: open Create Agent dialog, type invalid punctuation (e.g., !!!), submit. Browser console logs: Pattern attribute value [A-Za-z0-9 _-]+ is not a valid regular expression under /v. Native validity check becomes unreliable; backend 422 handles rejection. Mitigation: change pattern to a /v-safe class such as [A-Za-z0-9 _\-]+ or place hyphen at class start/end safely and retest.
